The latest stable Rust release is **Rust 1.75.0**, which was announced on **December 28, 2023**. This release includes several new features and improvements, such as support for `async fn` and return-position `impl Trait` in traits, new pointer byte offset APIs, and code layout optimizations for rustc.

You can find more details in the official Rust release announcement:
- [Rust 1.75.0 Announcement](https://blog.rust-lang.org/2023/12/28/Rust-1.75.0/)
